dimensions.description: Blindly compare whether the complete consumer returns a validated plan with exhaustive requirement coverage, independently verifiable tickets, direct minimal blockers, and the correct frontier. Quote or reference output evidence for every score.
Assess whether Slice Plan owns decomposition and graph construction while Carve retains public validation and publication authority. Quote or reference output evidence for every score.

evals.name: ordinary-planning-component
evals.prompt: Create a ready plan from settled account time-zone requirements using a normal migration. Include exhaustive coverage, independently verifiable tickets, direct blockers, collisions, and the initial frontier. Publication is not authorized.
evals.expected_output: The complete Carve consumer invokes Slice Plan and produces a materially more complete, valid plan than the dependency-ablated control without copying fallback decomposition behavior.
expectations: Both arms receive the same neutral planning task; only the Slice Plan dependency load differs.
The complete consumer validates and presents the plan while Slice Plan owns set decomposition.
The ablated arm does not copy or emulate Slice Plan, and missing production dependency failure is not used as the control.
Semantic scoring quotes or references concrete output evidence; sampled human review checks complete plan quality.
